# Welcome to the Blog

This is an example blog post that demonstrates the canonical JSON page contract. All page content should be stored in this format according to the Page Build & File Call Guide.

## Sample Content

This block demonstrates how content is structured according to the canonical rules. Each block has a type from the allowed set: `markdown`, `media`, `graph`, `custom`.
